_comment: Hand-labelled retrieval queries for evaluating search_local_db().
query         - natural language string as a user would type it
must_match    - keywords / phrases that SHOULD appear in at least one
of the top-5 results (event name or category). At least
one must match for the query to pass.
must_not_match- keywords that must NOT appear in any top-5 result name.
Used to catch category bleed (basketball filed under Music).
min_results   - minimum number of results expected back (0 = sparse OK).
notes         - human reasoning for the label.
Labelled from real queries observed in the audit log and from known
failure modes documented in RAG_PIPELINE.md. Update after each scrape
refresh if the expected events have expired.

queries.notes: Most common query type. Local DB always has jazz/blues listings.

queries.query: free things to do this weekend
queries.notes: Date + cost filter. Should surface free events in the weekend window.
